Through #digitalization, we can ensure that the next frontier of the #energy transition is not only clean -  but is just, fair and inclusive for everyone, everywhere. 
 
Digitalization is already reshaping energy systems; transforming how power is generated, distributed and delivered to the 666 million people who still lack electricity. By 2035, AI could help reduce emissions by up to 5.4 GtCO₂e annually (more than the current total emissions of India) by accelerating smarter, low-carbon solutions in energy, mobility and food systems that are already emerging around the world: 
 
🇰🇪 In Kenya, digital twins and geospatial mapping are already helping identify underserved areas in real-time; guiding last-mile electrification and boosting resilience in off-grid systems. 
 
🇮🇳 India is using AI to forecast energy demand and optimize power flows in rural microgrids; ensuring efficient delivery while minimizing losses and emissions. 
 
🇨🇴 In Colombia, digital cold chains powered by renewables are supporting remote health clinics and smallholder farmers, enabling vaccine access and food security in underserved regions. 
 
A just, sustainable future runs on digital energy solutions - grounded in local leadership, resilience and inclusion.
